8901-the-works-of-lord-byron-letters-and.creator: Unknown
8901-the-works-of-lord-byron-letters-and.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Catherine Gordon of Gight (1765-1811), afterwards Mrs. Byron, and mother of the poet, was descended on the paternal side from Sir William Gordon of Gight, the third son, by Annabella Stewart, daughter of James I of Scotland, of George, second Earl of Huntly, Chancellor of Scotland (1498-1502), and Lord-Lieutenant of the North from 1491 to his death in 1507.

arxiv-1503-09023.title: Differential Galois Theory and Lie Symmetries This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Algebraic Methods in Dynamical Systems. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/AMDS2014.html
arxiv-1503-09023.creator: David BLÁZQUEZ-SANZ †, Juan J. MORALES-RUIZ ‡ and Jacques-Arthur WEIL §
arxiv-1503-09023.description: Abstract We study the interplay between the differential Galois group and the Lie algebra of infinitesimal symmetries of systems of linear differential equations. We show that some symmetries can be seen as solutions of a hierarchy of linear differential systems.

arxiv-2012-06187.title: Quantum battery of interacting spins with environmental noise
arxiv-2012-06187.creator: Fang Zhao, Fu-Quan Dou, Qing Zhao
arxiv-2012-06187.description: Abstract A quantum battery is a temporary energy-storage system. We constructed the quantum battery model of an N-spin chain with nearest-neighbor hopping interaction and investigated the charging process of the quantum battery. We obtained the maximum energy in the quantum battery charged by a coherent cavity driving field or a thermal heat bath.

arxiv-2202-03538.title: Negative energy states in pionic hydrogen Thanks: Preprint Alberta Thy 1-22. Results of this paper were partially presented at Matter to the Deepest, September 15-17, 2021, Institute of Physics, University of Silesia, Poland.
arxiv-2202-03538.creator: Andrzej Czarnecki
arxiv-2202-03538.description: Abstract Probabilities of finding an antiparticle in an atom or ion containing a particle of spin 1/2 or spin 0 are determined. The spin 1/2 case was previously solved by Hans Bethe and his work is summarized. The spin 0 case is treated numerically for an arbitrary atomic number and analytically for small atomic numbers.

arxiv-2203-00527.title: Tensor-Train Split-Operator KSL (TT-SOKSL) Method for Quantum Dynamics Simulations
arxiv-2203-00527.creator: Ningyi Lyu, Micheline B. Soley, Victor S. Batista
arxiv-2203-00527.description: Abstract Numerically exact simulations of quantum reaction dynamics, including non-adiabatic effects in excited electronic states, are essential to gain fundamental insights into ultrafast chemical reactivity and rigorous interpretations of molecular spectroscopy. Here, we introduce the tensor-train split-operator KSL (TT-SOKSL) method for quantum simulations in tensor-train (TT)/matrix product state (MPS) representations.

arxiv-2209-04015.title: ipie : A Python-based Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo Program with Flexibility and Efficiency on CPUs and GPUs
arxiv-2209-04015.creator: Fionn D. Malone, Ankit Mahajan, James S. Spencer, Joonho Lee
arxiv-2209-04015.description: Abstract We report the development of a python-based auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC) program, ipie , with preliminary timing benchmarks and new AFQMC results on the isomerization of [ Cu 2 ​ O 2 ​ ] 2+ \text{[}\text{Cu}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{]}\text{}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}^{\text{2+}} . We demonstrate how implementations for both central and graphical processing units (CPUs and GPUs) are achieved in ipie .

arxiv-2209-09009.title: Robust Adaptive Generalized Correntropy-based Smoothed Graph Signal Recovery with a Kernel Width Learning
arxiv-2209-09009.creator: Razieh Torkamani, Hadi Zayyani, Farokh Marvasti
arxiv-2209-09009.description: Abstract This paper proposes a robust adaptive algorithm for smooth graph signal recovery which is based on generalized correntropy. A proper cost function is defined, which takes the smoothness and generalized correntropy into account. The generalized correntropy used in this paper employs the generalized Gaussian density (GGD) function as the kernel.

arxiv-2306-04611.title: Acoustic singular surfaces in an exponential class of inhomogeneous gases: A new numerical approach based on Krylov subspace spectral methodologies Note: Distribution Statement A: Approved for public release. Distribution is unlimited.
arxiv-2306-04611.creator: B. Rester, J. V. Lambers, P. M. Jordan
arxiv-2306-04611.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by B. Rester, J. V. Lambers, P. M. Jordan. We investigate the propagation of acoustic singular surfaces, specifically, linear shock waves and nonlinear acceleration waves, in a class of inhomogeneous gases whose ambient mass density varies exponentially. Employing the mathematical tools of singular surface theory, we first determine the evolution of both the jump amplitudes and the locations/velocities of their associated wave-fronts, along with a variety of related analytical results.

arxiv-2411-00670.title: In-situ formation of star clusters at z > 7 z>7 via galactic disk fragmentation; shedding light on ultra-compact clusters and overmassive black holes seen by JWST
arxiv-2411-00670.creator: Lucio Mayer, Floor van Donkelaar, Matteo Messa, Pedro R. Capelo, Angela Adamo
arxiv-2411-00670.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lucio Mayer, Floor van Donkelaar, Matteo Messa, Pedro R. Capelo, Angela Adamo. We investigate the nature of star formation in gas-rich galaxies at z > 7 z>7 forming in a markedly overdense region, in the whereabouts of a massive virialized halo already exceeding 10 12 10^{12} M ☉ .

arxiv-2501-18422.creator: E. Klinger, C. M. Rivera-Aguilar, A. Mursa, Q. Tanguy, N. Passilly, R. Boudot
arxiv-2501-18422.description: Abstract We describe the short-term frequency stability characterization of external-cavity diode lasers stabilized onto the 6 ​ S 1 / 2 − 7 ​ P 1 / 2 6\text{S}_{1/2}-7\text{P}_{1/2} transition of Cs atom at 459 nm, using a microfabricated vapor cell.

arxiv-2511-06453.title: Inflationary models in f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) gravity: Constraints from P ​ l ​ a ​ n ​ c ​ k Planck , BICEP/ K ​ e ​ c ​ k Keck , and Atacama
arxiv-2511-06453.creator: Biswajit Deb, Atri Deshamukhya
arxiv-2511-06453.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Biswajit Deb, Atri Deshamukhya. The advent of high-precision cosmological observations has challenged many traditional inflationary models. Data from P ​ l ​ a ​ n ​ c ​ k Planck 2018 along with the BICEP/ K ​ e ​ c ​ k Keck 2018 result have already ruled out most of the established models by placing tight constraints on the tensor-to-scalar ratio r r .

pmc-11421254.creator: Zhiwei Zhang, Yixuan Chen, Zhixi Chen, Zhenhong Gao, Yuying Cheng, Kunsheng Qu
pmc-11421254.description: Sea buckthorn (SB) primarily grows in northern China and is rich in nutritional components, making it popular among consumers. This study aims to select suitable SB varieties for processing by analyzing physicochemical components, color, taste, and volatile compounds. The results showed that the physicochemical content of Chinese SB from Gansu were as follows: total soluble solids 13.50 ± 0.

pmc-11432683.title: Hypoxia in Human Obesity: New Insights from Inflammation towards Insulin Resistance—A Narrative Review
pmc-11432683.creator: Maria Mirabelli, Roberta Misiti, Luciana Sicilia, Francesco S Brunetti, Eusebio Chiefari, Antonio Brunetti, Daniela P Foti, Pawel Dobrzyn, Galliera Emanuela Rita, Elena Vianello
pmc-11432683.description: Insulin resistance (IR), marked by reduced cellular responsiveness to insulin, and obesity, defined by the excessive accumulation of adipose tissue, are two intertwined conditions that significantly contribute to the global burden of cardiometabolic diseases. Adipose tissue, beyond merely storing triglycerides, acts as an active producer of biomolecules.

pmc-11547428.title: The Influence of Er and Zr on the Microstructure and Durability of the Mechanical Properties of an Al-Mg Alloy Containing 7 wt.% of Mg
pmc-11547428.creator: Kamila Limanówka, Sonia Boczkal, Monika Mitka, Elżbieta Szymańska, Joanna Hrabia-Wiśnios, Dawid Kapinos, Bogusław Augustyn, Renata Skrzyńska, Łukasz Grzebinoga, Paweł Czaja, Anna Góral, Tomasz Czeppe, Ki Buem Kim, Weimin Wang
pmc-11547428.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Al-Mg alloys are characterized by permanent solid solution hardening and can additionally be work-hardened. The high mechanical properties of Al-Mg alloys with above-standard Mg content obtained after plastic deformation processes decrease over time. The addition of minor alloying elements like Er or Zr is an alternative method to improve the durability of mechanical properties and increase the strength of Al-Mg alloys due to densely and evenly distributed dispersoids being formed.

pmc-11656733.title: PFAS-Free Energy Storage: Investigating Alternatives for Lithium-Ion Batteries
pmc-11656733.creator: Eleni K Savvidou, Amanda Rensmo, Jonathan P Benskin, Steffen Schellenberger, Xianfeng Hu, Marcel Weil, Ian T Cousins
pmc-11656733.description: The class-wide restriction proposal on perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the European Union is expected to affect a wide range of commercial sectors, including the lithium-ion battery (LIB) industry, where both polymeric and low molecular weight PFAS are used.

pmc-12398177.title: The association between diabetes management self-efficacy and quality of life among Palestinian patients with type 2 diabetes
pmc-12398177.creator: Romans Eshtaya, Ahmad Ayed, Malakeh. Z. Malak, Anas Shehadeh
pmc-12398177.description: BackgroundSelf-efficacy emerges as a crucial element that impacts engagement in self-care behaviors among patients with type 2 diabetes. There is a lack of studies examining management self-efficacy and quality of life among patients with type 2 diabetes in Palestine. Thus, this study examined these variables among this cohort.

pmc-12473412.title: Experimental Study of Liquid and Gas Gate Valve Internal Leakage Testing Based on Ultrasonic Signal
pmc-12473412.creator: Tingwei Wang, Xinjia Ma, Shiqiang Zhang, Qiang Feng, Xiaomei Xiang, Hui Xia
pmc-12473412.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study presents an experimental analysis of high-pressure liquid and gas gate valve leakage under multiple operating conditions, based on the variation patterns of ultrasonic signals. Focusing on a multi-physics field analysis of gate valve internal leakage and corresponding experiments, this research illustrates the acoustic wave characteristics of gate valves across diverse working media, pressures, internal leakage defect sizes, and valve diameters.

pmc-12474066.title: Assessing Multiple Risks in Regulating Reservoirs: Perspectives on Heavy Metal Contamination
pmc-12474066.creator: Hui Zhou, Zhiping Li, Anming Wang, Jiawei Zhu, Zongyuan Han, Yalin Zhang, Dongdong Chen, Luis Alberto Henríquez-Hernández
pmc-12474066.description: As the terminal reservoir of the South-to-North Water Diversion’s Eastern Route, Dongping Lake is critical for safeguarding the northern water supply. Analysis of 33 water–sediment sites revealed the following. (1) Waterborne heavy metals (HMs) below WHO limits, confirming the good water quality.

pmc-12507791.title: Frontiers of optic nerve regeneration research: an analysis of the top 100 most influential articles in the field from 2005 to 2025
pmc-12507791.creator: Saijilafu, Peng Chen, Lingchen Ye, Yuxi Shen, Qi Wang, Xuanwen Chen, Chimedragchaa Chimedtseren, Junqian Zhang, Linjun Fang, Renjie Xu
pmc-12507791.description: ObjectivesIn this study, we evaluated the key features of the 100 most-cited publications on optic nerve regeneration from 2005 to 2025 employing bibliometric and visual analysis.MethodsThe data for this study were obtained from a comprehensive search across multiple databases, including the Web of Science, Scopus, and Dimensions.

pmc-12550236.title: Exploring the mechanism of Qiling Jiaogulan Powder in protecting heart injury of heat-stressed broilers based on transcriptome
pmc-12550236.creator: Juan Yu, Qing Wang, Min Xu, Shangbin Wang, Yanzhao Xu, Hongxuan He
pmc-12550236.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The heart serves as the center of blood circulation, transporting oxygen and nutrients to all tissues and organs of the body. Cardiac function is closely associated with the growth performance, immune function, and meat quality of broilers. In this study, a broiler heat stress (HS) model was established by artificially controlling environmental temperature, and transcriptomic analysis was used to investigate the effect and underlying mechanisms of Qiling Jiaogulan Powder (QLJP) on heat stress-induced heart injury in broilers.

pmc-12565210.title: Vaginal Microbiome and Functional Pathway Alterations in Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes Revealed by 16S rRNA Sequencing
pmc-12565210.creator: Sangho Nam, Subeen Hong, In Yang Park, Sun Shin
pmc-12565210.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) is a leading cause of preterm birth and significant neonatal morbidity. The vaginal microbiome is implicated in its pathogenesis, but its detailed characteristics and functional consequences remain to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to provide a comprehensive, multi-faceted analysis of the vaginal microbiome and its functional potential in pregnant women with PPROM compared to healthy term controls. We collected vaginal fluid samples from eight PPROM and seven healthy control (HC) pregnant women.

pmc-13045269.title: Early Recurrence of Mediastinal Germ Cell Tumor With Pathological Complete Response to Chemotherapy: A Case Report
pmc-13045269.creator: Risa Kanai, Satoshi Yokoyama, Daisuke Fukao, Masahiko Sakabe, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13045269.description: Primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors (GCTs) are rare pediatric tumors that have a poorer prognosis than GCTs occurring elsewhere in the body. Due to their rarity and aggressiveness, they are often locally advanced and unresectable at diagnosis, and currently, there is no standard optimal treatment approach.

pmc-13229777.title: Retrobulbar spot sign in non-ischemic conditions: a case series challenging its diagnostic role
pmc-13229777.creator: Chuanjie Yin, Jiezhi Zhan, Xiliang He, Zhaohu Yu, Yu Sun, Shanshan Zhang, Huadong Lou
pmc-13229777.description: ObjectivesTo present three cases where the retrobulbar spot sign (RBSS) was observed, but central retinal artery occlusion (CRAO) was not confirmed.MethodsTransorbital sonography was employed to detect the presence of RBSS in all patients.ResultsRBSS was detected in all three patients. However, only one patient had CRAO, with RBSS-positive findings in both eyes, although one eye showed normal function.

pmc-13313146.title: Testosterone Replacement Therapy as a Foundation for Body Composition Remodeling: Synergistic Roles of Resistance Training and Protein Intake
pmc-13313146.creator: Luis M Canal de Velasco, José Emiliano González Flores, Gabriel Kraus Fischer, Mariana de la Vega, Jose Luis Morales Arteaga, Andres Bello Margalef, Santiago Segón Mora, Alan Abruch-Fleisher, Alberto Azcona Cervera
pmc-13313146.description: Testosterone plays a central role in the regulation of body composition, skeletal muscle metabolism, and metabolic health in men. Testosterone deficiency is frequently associated with increased adiposity, reduced lean body mass, impaired physical performance, and adverse metabolic profiles, contributing to the development of sarcopenia and cardiometabolic disease.

pmc-13582511.title: Shift work, sociodemographic factors, and sleep quality among nurses working in rotating and day shifts: a cross-sectional analysis
pmc-13582511.creator: Maaidah M. Algamdi, Mashael Hasan Alamrani
pmc-13582511.description: BackgroundNurses’ sleep quality is vital for their health and well-being, especially given their demanding, irregular schedules. This study examined associations between work schedule, shift selection, and sociodemographic factors and sleep quality among nurses in Saudi Arabia.MethodsA self-reported, descriptive cross-sectional study used a two-part questionnaire comprising sociodemographic data and the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (internal consistency α = .824).
